question: Please list the full names of all the superheroes with over 15 super powers.
clarification: Count the value 15 itself as included.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id GROUP BY T1.full_name HAVING COUNT(T2.power_id) >= 15
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id GROUP BY T1.full_name HAVING COUNT(T2.power_id) > 15

d.request: Please list the full names of all superheroes with 15 or more super powers.
d.sql: SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) >= 15

b.request: List the full names of superheroes who have 15 or more superpowers
b.sql: SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) >= 15
